name: dashboard
label: Dashboard
css: .style-dashboard { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #09090b 0%, #0f0f13 100%); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); border: 1px solid rgba(12, 92, 171, 0.2); border-radius: 20px; padding: 60px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; height: 100%; box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(250, 250, 250, 0.1); } .style-dashboard::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -50%; right: -50%; width: 200%; height: 200%; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(12, 92, 171, 0.08) 0%, transparent 70%); pointer-events: none; animation: drift 20s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes drift { 0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0); } 50% { transform: translate(30px, 30px); } } .style-dashboard .hook { font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: -2px; color: #fafafa; line-height: 1.1; margin: 0; position: relative; z-index: 2; text-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3); } .style-dashboard .text { font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(250, 250, 250, 0.85); line-height: 1.3; margin: 24px 0 0 0; position: relative; z-index: 2; max-width: 90%; } .style-dashboard .step { position: absolute; top: 40px; right: 40px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; color: rgba(12, 92, 171, 0.12); line-height: 1; z-index: 1; letter-spacing: -4px; } .style-dashboard .brand { position: absolute; bottom: 40px; left: 60px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(12, 92, 171, 0.7); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; z-index: 2; } .slide-code.style-dashboard { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #050507 0%, #0a0a0e 100%); border: 1px solid rgba(12, 92, 171, 0.15); } .slide-code.style-dashboard .hook, .slide-code.style-dashboard .text { color: #fafafa; } .slide-code.style-dashboard .hook { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: 0; } .slide-insight.style-dashboard { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0c2340 0%, #091e3a 100%); border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2); } .slide-insight.style-dashboard .hook { color: #10b981; text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3); } .slide-insight.style-dashboard .text { color: rgba(250, 250, 250, 0.9); } .slide-insight.style-dashboard .insight-text { font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 42px; font-weight: 600; color: #10b981; line-height: 1.4; position: relative; z-index: 2; margin: 16px 0; text-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.25); }
